_meta.law: source of truth for collections. a collection holds pages of one section. a multi-collection holds collections. engine: tools/build.py.

collections.title: The Hitman Collection
collections.caption: the four hits the owner listed, 2002 to 2012. the barcode's classic run on one shelf.
about: The Hitman games the archive's list actually names: Silent Assassin's conscience, Contracts' dark detour, Blood Money's sandbox peak, Absolution's cinematic detour. Codename 47 and the World of Assassination trilogy are not on the list - they wait in the wings until the owner calls for them.

The classics (2002-2006) run on and under the haswell iGPU bar and are still sold DRM-free. Absolution sits at the target line with its 24GB body. Every page carries the same law: official path first where one exists, the archive route right next to it.
notes: Codename 47, the World of Assassination trilogy and the spinoffs (GO, Sniper, Sniper Challenge) are out of the current scope - attic'd, not judged. they come back when the owner wants them.

collections.title: The Chicken Invaders Collection
collections.caption: the classic line: five wars, 1999 to 2014, every holiday release riding as a version.
about: One hundred percent of the classic Chicken Invaders line the owner listed: the five mainline episodes, with every holiday release the series shipped living as a version under its episode's page - Christmas x4, Easter x2, Halloween x1, Thanksgiving x1 - switched from the dropdown, not scattered as standalone catalog entries.

The production quirk the shelf keeps honest: the third war's Christmas Edition (November 2006) shipped before the standard game (January 2007), making it the only edition in the series that predates its own episode.

InterAction studios is alive and every entry on this shelf is still obtainable through an official channel: the studio's own download hub carries the whole line, and Steam sells the mainline episodes and all eight holiday editions (every app page and price verified 2026-10-09). these pages are ownership stories, not rescues - the archive links ride along for preservation.
notes: Chicken Invaders Universe (2018, early access to 2022) is on the owner's list - catalogued, waiting its dig. free to play since 1.0 (2022-12-15).

Chicken Invaders: Remastered is not a game of its own: it is the studio's remaster line covering all classic episodes and their DLCs, and the direct upgrade of every old game on this shelf. each page carries the upgrade line.
